description: Toybox 10K family and story characters: the Bear family (Baby, Mommy, Daddy, Grandpa, Grandma, Auntie and Uncle Bear) and a polar bear from the catalog bear; grown-up, grandparent and baby variants of bunny, frog, monkey, penguin, dog, camel, squirrel, lion, pig and fish; a sun, a crescent moon, North Wind, a water spirit, a scarecrow, oni and troll grumps; story people on the toddler body (Jun, his father, the shoemaker and his wife, an old emperor, an elf, village children). Generated by tools/gen_tk_family.mjs: edit the generator, not this file.

baby_bear.description: Baby Bear: a tiny round honey-colored bear cub (0.63 m) in a pale blue knitted romper with a heart, a curl of fur on top and big eyes; crawls, toddles, babbles and reaches up to be held (arms).

mommy_bear.description: Mommy Bear: a soft brown grown-up bear (1.2 m) with a pink flowery headscarf tied at the back, rosy cheeks and a warm smile; gives big gentle cuddles (arms). Bear family.

daddy_bear.description: Daddy Bear: a big soft brown grown-up bear (1.35 m) in a green knitted sweater with two cream stripes, with a gentle laugh; arms for hugs and waves. Bear family with Mommy Bear and Baby Bear.

grandpa_bear.description: Grandpa Bear: an older brown bear (1.23 m) with a gray muzzle, bushy white brows, round glasses and a deep red knitted cardigan over a cream shirt; gentle smile. Bear family.

grandma_bear.description: Grandma Bear: an older brown bear (1.18 m) with a gray muzzle, round glasses, a little white top bun and a long purple knitted cardigan; sings softly. Bear family.

auntie_bear.description: Auntie Bear: a young grown-up chestnut bear (1.18 m) in a bright yellow raincoat with a rolled hood and white buttons, with a big laugh. Bear family.

uncle_bear.description: Uncle Bear: a tall brown grown-up bear (1.3 m, 1.45 m with the hat) in a red-and-white striped knit hat with a pom-pom and a guitar on his back (named part guitar); plays a soft strum. Bear family.

polar_bear.description: A big cream-white polar bear (1.4 m) with a white tummy, black nose, small round ears and wide furry paws (named arm); slides on ice and paddles with its front paws.

big_rabbit.description: Big Rabbit (Father Rabbit, Bunny's dad): a large grown-up gray rabbit (1.75 m to the ear tips) with long ears, a red knitted scarf and arms; deep, kind voice.

pet_rabbit.description: A small soft gray pet rabbit (0.8 m to the ear tips) with long upright ears, a white muzzle and tummy and a white bobtail (named tail); twitches its nose.

grandma_frog.description: Grandma Frog: an older moss-green frog with round glasses on her eye bumps, white brows, a purple knitted shawl and little arms for folding paper; gentle smile.

grandma_monkey.description: Grandma Monkey: an older brown monkey with gray cheek fur and brows, round glasses and a bright teal shawl; gentle and smiling.

grandpa_penguin.description: Grandpa Penguin: an older, taller emperor-style penguin (1.35 m) with a pale gray chest, gold ear patches, white brows and a red knitted scarf; calm, wise smile; holds out a flipper to help.

big_brother_dog.description: Big Brother Dog: a bigger, older puppy (1.35 m) in a white sailor's cap and a blue-and-white striped top, with arms; calm and kind.

camel_cousin.description: Camel Cousin: a slightly taller sandy camel (1.45 m) with a red-and-gold striped saddle blanket with tassels and a friendly smile.

squirrel_kit.description: A squirrel kit: a small young red-brown squirrel (0.6 m) with an extra-fluffy tail, big eyes and bouncy movements.

chip.description: Chip, Squirrel's little brother: a small young brown squirrel (0.6 m) with an extra-fluffy tail, wide excited eyes and a too-big acorn-cap hat (named hat).

lion_king.description: Lion King: an old lion with a pale straw mane, white brows, a simple little gold crown and a purple robe with a white collar; can rest in bed, then stand well and smiling.

piglet.description: A small pink piglet (0.68 m) in sky-blue pajamas with white stripes and a curly tail (named tail); snuggles under a quilt and giggles.

golden_fish.description: A large golden fish (1.3 m) with pale gold stripes, shimmering glints and kind eyes that rises to the surface of a pond.

uncle_fish.description: Uncle Fish: a bigger, older orange fish with a gray-tipped top fin (named fin), white brows, a kind smile and a little blue octagon-shaped hat (named hat).

jun.description: Jun: a boy of about seven (1.35 m) in a simple blue tunic and darker blue pants with neat black hair and brown eyes; gentle and careful, loves growing flowers. Toddler-body poses (arm_l, fore_l, leg) work.

jun_father.description: Jun's father: a calm grown-up man (1.65 m) in a simple gray work tunic with a belt, charcoal pants and a gardener's wide straw hat (named hat); kneels to talk to his son. Toddler-body poses work.

shoemaker.description: A kind, thin older shoemaker (1.55 m) with gray hair, small round spectacles (named glasses), a leather apron (named apron), a cream shirt with rolled sleeves and brown trousers. Toddler-body poses work.

shoemaker_wife.description: The shoemaker's wife: a warm, practical older woman (1.5 m) with gray hair in a bun, a long rose dress with a white apron and a purple knitted shawl (named shawl); sews tiny clothes by lamplight. Toddler-body poses work.

old_emperor.description: A kind, very old emperor (1.55 m) with a long white beard, white hair, a plain golden robe with a red sash and a simple dark round hat; walks slowly with a smile; drawn respectfully in storybook style. Toddler-body poses work.

elf.description: A tiny friendly elf (0.47 m, knee-high to a cat) with pointed ears and a cheerful face in a red waistcoat (named waistcoat), green cap (cap) and pointy red shoes (shoes) over plain sand-colored clothes; drop those three for the thin, worn first look; sews fast and dances a jig.

sun_character.description: A warm, round, smiling sun figure (1.25 m): a glowing gold ball with twelve soft orange rays (named rays, they wave), big brown eyes, rosy cheeks, little arms and legs; walks on the ground or floats up with `at`.

moon_character.description: A gentle crescent-moon figure (1.4 m): a pale glowing yellow crescent with a calm smile, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks and little legs and arms; walks beside Sun and can drift up into the night sky with `at`.

north_wind.description: North Wind: a puffy gray cloud (1.6 m wide, floats: lift it with `at`) with round puffed cheeks, a frown under heavy brows and soft white swirly gusts in front (named gust); huffs harder and harder.

water_spirit.description: A friendly water spirit (1.3 m): a flowing see-through blue figure of water with a drop-shaped curl on top, a wave hem, soft arms and two little orange fish swimming inside (named fish); can rise and fill a room gently.

scarecrow.description: A friendly straw scarecrow (1.65 m) on a wooden pole (named pole) in a patched brown coat, arms out with straw hands (named arm), a burlap head with button eyes and a stitched smile, straw hair and a straw hat (named hat).

oni_grump.description: Oni Grump: a big, round, comic oni (1.55 m) with a rosy body, two small rounded cream horns (named horns), curly dark hair, a huge round nose, bushy brows and a yellow tiger-stripe wrap; blustery but never scary (no fangs); sneezes enormously.

troll_grump.description: Troll Grump: a grumpy-but-comic round mossy green troll (1.15 m) with big ears (named ears), a long droopy nose (named nose), a grass tuft of hair, leaf patches and a brown tunic; lives under a bridge, splashes and paddles away grumbling; never scary.

village_children.description: Village children: a small storybook crowd of three children (about 1.15 m) in simple teal, yellow and red tunics, each carrying a pot of bright flowers (named pots); the middle child has the talking face, all drawn warmly.
